work.headline: Turning complex data into dependable business processes.
work.intro: Representative examples are described without confidential business details.

items.title: Historical Data Reconciliation
items.text: Reconciled decades of historical participation records across a legacy CRM and archived spreadsheets, resolving incomplete, conflicting, and ambiguous entries.
items.result: Produced a cleaner, more reliable dataset for reporting and migration.

items.title: CRM Migration & Reporting Continuity
items.text: Supported a migration from a legacy association management system to a Salesforce-based platform by validating records, recreating report logic, identifying invalid transactions and test data, and updating reporting rules.
items.result: Helped preserve reporting continuity while improving the quality of data entering the new system.

items.title: Legacy Workflow Analysis
items.text: Investigated an unfamiliar Microsoft Access workflow, identified its data structure and business rules, resolved reporting issues, and documented the current process.
items.result: Documented the data structure, business rules, and known issues needed to rebuild the process in a modern platform.

items.title: Reporting & Audience Segmentation
items.text: Own recurring and ad hoc reporting processes used by sales, marketing, operations, and leadership, translating business questions into queries, audience segments, and usable outputs.
items.result: Provided teams with dependable reports, audience segments, and analysis for ongoing business needs.

capabilities.headline: Turning business needs into working data solutions.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics
items.text: Translate business questions into recurring reports, ad hoc analysis, audience segments, and clear outputs using SQL, Excel, Power Query, Salesforce, and related systems.

items.title: Data Quality & Migration
items.text: Reconcile conflicting sources, validate imports and mappings, identify reporting risks, and help maintain continuity while systems and data structures change.

items.title: Business Systems & Process Improvement
items.text: Learn unfamiliar systems quickly, document how workflows and business rules operate, and improve processes so they are easier to support and maintain.

experience.headline: Experience across data, software, and quality assurance.

items.text: Own recurring and ad hoc reporting for sales, marketing, operations, and leadership. Support the transition from a legacy business system to Salesforce through data validation, report development, migration testing, audience segmentation, troubleshooting, field configuration, formulas, and process documentation.
Developed SQL and Python tools, ETL workflows, internal automation, data-transfer processes, and user-facing applications.

roles.text: Moved into paid development support after beginning as a volunteer contributor. Participated in internal development boards and tested live-service updates before public beta release. Performed regression testing, reproduced defects, validated workflows and data, and documented findings for developers.
Tested game systems, reproduced technical issues, validated data consistency, and documented defects. Earned additional access and responsibility through consistent and reliable contributions.

items.text: Academic foundation in software development, databases, systems design, and technical problem-solving. Certified ScrumMaster.

skills.headline: A practical technical toolkit that continues to grow.

learning.label: Salesforce & business systems
learning.headline: Hands-on platform experience
learning.text: Work includes Salesforce-based reporting, field configuration, formulas, data validation, migration support, issue investigation, and process development. I continue to expand my platform knowledge through self-directed Trailhead learning and formal training opportunities.

about.headline: I bridge business needs, data, and technical systems.
text: My background includes software development, quality assurance, data operations, and business systems. That experience helps me learn unfamiliar tools quickly and understand both how systems work and why the business uses them.

I enjoy solving problems where the data is incomplete, the process is unclear, or the system is changing. My goal is to leave behind something accurate, understandable, and easier for others to maintain.
My current focus is expanding my ownership of Salesforce-based reporting, data processes, automation, and marketing audience architecture.

contact.headline: Let’s make complex data easier to use.
